items.title: Record a read-only retrospective input-contamination audit for current B-991d rows
items.context: After B-991d reaches a stable checkpoint, inspect run-full.mjs, prompt construction, env policy, workspace policy, and representative row metadata. Do not write provider rows or rerun provider calls. Acceptance: audit classifies current rows as weak-clean, strong-clean, or contaminated with evidence pointers.

happy.desc: Audit artifact records concrete evidence for prompt, workspace, env, and row metadata contamination surfaces.

edge.desc: Historical rows without explicit memory fields are classified as weak-clean rather than silently upgraded.

adversarial.desc: Any discovered session_brief/dev-memory/playbook/runtime guidance injection is classified as contamination, not waived.

items.title: Add explicit memory/isolation metadata to future Cell03 result rows
items.context: Add row fields such as memoryPolicy, sessionBriefInjected, devMemoryInjected, playbookRuntime, parentRepoRulesVisible, and runnerIsolation for future rows after the audit checkpoint. Acceptance: new rows can prove memory/runtime guidance was not injected without relying on code inspection alone.
excludes: retroactively editing completed provider row truth
provider API calls from this audit story

happy.desc: New row metadata explicitly records memory and runtime-guidance non-injection fields.

edge.desc: Rows created before this metadata are handled by compatibility classification, not by destructive rewrite.

adversarial.desc: Validator rejects strong-clean claims when any required memory/isolation field is missing or contradictory.

items.title: Extend validation to enforce clean-input claims without breaking historical rows
items.context: Update the Cell03 validator so strong-clean rows require explicit non-injection metadata, while historical B-991d rows remain valid only under a weaker clean-claim classification. Acceptance: validator reports counts by clean-claim tier and rejects contradictory metadata.

happy.desc: Validator reports weak-clean and strong-clean counts separately.

edge.desc: Historical rows without explicit fields do not fail ordinary row validation but cannot count as strong-clean.

adversarial.desc: Contradictory fields such as sessionBriefInjected=true with cleanClaim=strong are rejected.

items.title: Document DGX/Docker clean-runner launch requirements
items.context: Capture the stricter launch policy for future DGX/Docker runs: no .lattice mount, no dev-memory/playbooks, no session_brief injection, frozen inputs read-only, shard-local outputs, and provider API credentials only through env/secret. Acceptance: future clean runner can be launched with an auditable isolation statement.
excludes: building the Docker runner in this audit story unless explicitly approved later

happy.desc: Document states DGX/Docker clean-runner requirements and required runner-isolation metadata.

edge.desc: Document distinguishes product workflow memory from experiment-runner model input.

adversarial.desc: Document forbids mounting the full Proofbound repo or CODEX_HOME into the clean runner unless explicitly classified.
